plugins.name: claudinho
plugins.description: Your Claude Code celebrates when your team scores: a toast with the scorer, a short celebration with the Claude mascot, and the score above your prompt. Follow a competition and pin your team with the claudinho CLI on your machine, then open any match's goals and cards with /claudinho match. Live data: ESPN. Not affiliated with FIFA, any confederation, league or club, or Anthropic.
